title: Beer - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue, at home (e.g., revenue generated in supermarkets and convenience stores) in the Beer market amounts to US$358.40bn in 2026.
Revenue, out-of-home (e.g., revenue generated in restaurants and bars) amounts to US$317.31bn in 2026.
Revenue, combined amounts to US$675.71bn in 2026.
The revenue, at home is expected to grow annually by 2.73% (CAGR 2026-2030).
In global comparison, most revenue, at home is generated United States (US$83bn in 2026).
In relation to total population figures, the average revenue per capita, at home of US$45.34 are generated in 2026.
In the Beer market, volume, at home is expected to amount to 125.07bn L by 2026.
Volume, out-of-home is expected to amount to 52.56bn L in 2026.
Volume, combined is expected to amount to 177.63bn L in 2026.
The Beer market is expected to show a volume growth, at home of -0.2% in 2027.
The average volume per person, at home in the Beer market is expected to amount to 15.82L in 2026.
